# NLP-4MAT Presentation Studio (`nlp-4-mat`) v0.4.0

Interactive 4MAT presentation studio: progressive interview, source-grounded claim ledger, audience and format adaptation, storyboard, production, independent review and rehearsal, with optional evidence-aware NLP communication tools.

This package is generated for **Claude (Claude Code, claude.ai, Claude Desktop, mobile, Cowork)** from https://github.com/blackandcode/NLP-4-MAT-Presentation-AI-Skill.
Edit the sources there, not these files. The full installation and publishing guide is [docs/DISTRIBUTION.md](https://github.com/blackandcode/NLP-4-MAT-Presentation-AI-Skill/blob/main/docs/DISTRIBUTION.md).

Start by asking in plain language, for example: "Help me turn my thesis and notes into a 15-minute 4MAT defense for my examiners."

Privacy: no data collection; see PRIVACY.md. License: MIT.
